newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ rights 98 pct taken up - Aust. Fin Review.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ rights 98 pct taken up - Aust. Fin Review.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd's NZ$240 million rights issue closed last week 98 percent subscribed, the Australian Financial Review (AFR) reported on Wednesday.
"At last count, we were 98 per cent subscribed which was pretty good," AFR quoted Air NZ spokesman David Beatson as saying. Beatson was unavailable for comment to Reuters.
AFR said Qantas Airways Ltd had taken up its NZ$47 million share of the issue, investing indirectly in the rival alliance forged by the NZ carrier with Ansett Holdings Ltd.
The pro rata issue was for 121 million new shares at a heavily discounted NZ$2 a share.
AFR said it was understood that Qantas exercised its full entitlements to maintain its strategic holding at 19.4 percent.

Under the 3-for-11 offering, Qantas would have acquired a further 23.5 million "B" shares in Air NZ at a cost of $NZ47 million to avoid its stake - the second biggest after Brierley Investments Ltd - being diluted to 15.3 per cent.
The move was unexpected, given the increasing speculation that Qantas would exit its shareholding following the completion of Air NZ's deal to buy 50 per cent of Ansett, AFR said.
By accepting its entitlements, Qantas had protected the value of its seven-year-old investment, AFR said.
